spec_family.name: Drywall Walls — New Construction — Finish Coats (SF Field + LF Edges)
spec_family.description: Finish coats for primed drywall walls in new construction. Models field work as SF and edge/cut-line work as LF using PaintScope-derived perimeter/opening geometry. Supports tape-line cut-to-tape (typical sprayed trim sequence) and freehand cut-in. Assumes priming has been completed under SF_DRYWALL_BARE_NC_PRIME. Does not include ceilings (separate ceiling finish spec).

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier affects sanding and inspection rigor between coats.
Jobsite condition affects protection and workflow.
Wall sheen affects defect visibility and expected discipline.
Color/hide difficulty impacts coat discipline and touch-up likelihood.
How edges are produced against adjacent finishes (trim/ceiling).

paintable_items.name: Primed Drywall Wall Field Area
paintable_items.counting_rules: Measure wall field area in square feet (total wall SF minus openings per estimating policy).
paintable_items.notes: Derived from PaintScope room measurements: perimeter × height minus openings.

paintable_items.name: Wall Edge / Cut Line Length
paintable_items.counting_rules: Total linear feet of cut lines against adjacent finishes (trim and/or ceiling) derived from PaintScope geometry.
paintable_items.notes: In new construction, edges are often tape-line cut-to-tape against sprayed trim.

variants.notes: Typical NC sequence where trim is (or will be) sprayed enamel and wall paint cuts to tape line.
Used when tape-line is not required or not practical; includes LF-based cut-in work.

assumptions: Walls are primed and accepted prior to finish coats under SF_DRYWALL_BARE_NC_PRIME.
PaintScope provides room geometry sufficient to compute wall SF and relevant edge LF.
Trim and ceiling specs are separate; this spec only models wall finishing + edge lines.
exclusions: Major drywall repair beyond minor touch-up
